messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D creature-battle game for phones and tablets in the existing project.

## Requirements
- Deliver the game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them when finishing.
- Support responsive touch play on phones/tablets.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) and read only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created an original creature-battle game, “Wildbound — Creature Clash,” rather than using Pokémon characters or branding.
- Used Three.js from jsDelivr and procedurally generated 3D creatures and arena scenery.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added a standalone game implementation in `index.html` with battle turns, attacks, healing, team switching/recruitment, experience/level-ups, win/loss states, keyboard shortcuts, and responsive controls.
- Added responsive arena framing adjustments for portrait screens.
- Validated JavaScript syntax and tested desktop and mobile layouts in Chromium; no page errors were reported in the latest test.
- Saved and inspected the latest screenshot at `screenshots/wildbound.jpg`.

### Active
- Final verification after the most recent camera framing changes.

### Blocked
- `(none)`

## Next Move
1. Run syntax and browser checks after the latest `fitView()` edits; inspect the latest screenshot if needed.
2. Review `git status` and provide a concise completion note mentioning the original-creature assumption.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; all interface, 3D scene, and battle logic.
- `screenshots/wildbound.jpg`: Latest saved visual check.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The last edits introduced `fitView()` and changed `setFoeModel()` to call it; these edits have not yet been retested.

content.text:
Built **Wildbound — Creature Clash**, a playable 3D creature-battle game in `index.html`. It includes turn-based moves, healing, team switching and recruitment, leveling, and responsive touch controls for phones and tablets.

I used original creatures rather than Pokémon characters or branding. JavaScript syntax and a mobile browser battle check passed; the latest screenshot is `screenshots/wildbound.jpg`.
